source_refs.note: Book p. 94: 6.3 Arithmetic Mean definition, A = (a + b)/2, side Note on n A.M.s, Example 6. Teaching notes, Key points, Common mistakes are ours.

blocks.text: Aap ne "average" ka lafz zaroor suna hoga: do imtihanon mein 60 aur 80 number aaye to average 70. Aaj ka sabaq isi average ka A.P. wala roop hai, jise arithmetic mean (hisaabi ausat), mukhtasar A.M., kehte hain. Saath hi seekhenge ke do numbers ke darmiyan ek se zyada A.M.s kaise "daale" (insert kiye) jate hain.

A number \(A\) is said to be the A.M. (arithmetic mean) between two numbers \(a\) and \(b\) if \(a, A, b\) are in A.P. If \(d\) is the common difference of this A.P., then \(A - a = d\) and \(b - A = d\). Thus

blocks.text_alt: A equals a plus b, over 2

blocks.text: Dekhiye yeh formula kaise bana: \(a, A, b\) A.P. mein hain, to pehla farq \(A - a\) aur doosra farq \(b - A\) barabar hone chahiye, kyun ke A.P. mein farq hamesha same rehta hai. Dono ko barabar likha, \(A\) ko ek taraf jama kiya to \(2A = a + b\), aur 2 se divide karne par \(A = \frac{a + b}{2}\). Yani A.M. bilkul wahi average hai jo aap jaante hain.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: If \(A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}, \ldots, A_{n}\) are said to be \(n\) A.M.s between two numbers \(a\) and \(b\), then \(a, A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}, \ldots, A_{n}, b\) are in A.P.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Number line par socheiye: A.M. \(a\) aur \(b\) ke bilkul beech mein hota hai. Misaal: 4 aur 10 ka A.M. \(\frac{4 + 10}{2} = 7\); aur \(4, 7, 10\) A.P. hai jis ka \(d = 3\).
Ab "\(n\) A.M.s daalna" ka matlab: \(a\) aur \(b\) ke darmiyan \(n\) numbers aise bharna ke poori list A.P. ban jaye. Jaise do khambon (poles) ke darmiyan barabar faasle par baaqi khambe gaarna.
Kyun yeh samajhna zaroori hai? Kyun ke tab list mein kul \(n + 2\) terms hoti hain: \(a\) pehli term aur \(b\) \((n + 2)\)th term. Is liye \(d\) is se nikalta hai: \(b = a + (n + 1)d\). Yahi raaz har aise sawal ki chaabi hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a\) aur \(b\) khud means nahin hain; means sirf beech wale numbers hain.
Ab kitab ki misaal dekhte hain, jis mein numbers surds (jaise \(\sqrt{2}\)) hain, taa ke hisaab ki mashq bhi ho jaye.

blocks.title: Example 6
steps:
Given: \(a = \sqrt{2}\), \(b = 3\sqrt{2}\), teen A.M.s daalne hain.
To find: \(A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}\).
Method: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke Note ke mutabiq \(\sqrt{2}, A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}, 3\sqrt{2}\) A.P. mein hain. Yeh 5 terms hain: \(a_{1} = \sqrt{2}\) aur \(a_{5} = 3\sqrt{2}\). To \(a_{5} = a_{1} + 4d\) se \(d\) nikalenge, phir \(d\) baar baar jama kar ke means.

Step 1: \(d\) nikaalein
\[a_{5} = a_{1} + (5-1)d\]
\[3\sqrt{2} = \sqrt{2} + 4d\]
\[4d = 2\sqrt{2}\]
\[d = \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{4} = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(3\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{2} = 2\sqrt{2}\), bilkul jaise \(3x - x = 2x\); \(\sqrt{2}\) ko ek cheez samjhiye. Aur \(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) kyun ke \(2 = \sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{2}\), to upar neeche ek \(\sqrt{2}\) cancel ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: 5 terms hain, is liye \(4d\); \(3d\) likhna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Step 2: Pehla mean
\[A_{1} = a_{1} + d = \sqrt{2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2 + 1}{\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: jama karne ke liye denominator ek jaisa chahiye, is liye \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{2}}\) likha (upar neeche \(\sqrt{2}\) se multiply).

Step 3: Doosra mean
\[A_{2} = A_{1} + d = \dfrac{3}{\sqrt{2}} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{4}{\sqrt{2}} = 2\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: denominator pehle se same hai, numerators jama kiye. Phir \(\frac{4}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{2 \times 2}{\sqrt{2}} = 2\sqrt{2}\), kyun ke \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{2}\).

Step 4: Teesra mean
\[A_{3} = A_{2} + d = 2\sqrt{2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 + 1}{\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(2\sqrt{2} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{2}}\) likh kar numerators jama kiye.

Tasdeeq:
Agar hum ne sahi kiya hai to aakhri mean mein ek aur \(d\) jama karne se \(b\) aana chahiye: \(\frac{5}{\sqrt{2}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{2}} = 3\sqrt{2}\). Bilkul sahi!
Doosri tasdeeq: beech wala mean dono kinaron ka A.M. hona chahiye: \(\frac{\sqrt{2} + 3\sqrt{2}}{2} = \frac{4\sqrt{2}}{2} = 2\sqrt{2} = A_{2}\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. \(-6\) aur \(14\) ka A.M.? (Jawab: \(\frac{-6 + 14}{2} = 4\).)
2. 4 A.M.s daalne hon to list mein kul kitni terms hongi? (Jawab: 6; \(b\) 6th term hoga, \(b = a + 5d\).)
3. Kitab ke jawab \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\) ko rationalize karein to? (\(\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}\); dono ek hi number hain.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin.) 2 aur 11 ke darmiyan do A.M.s daaliye.
List: \(2, A_{1}, A_{2}, 11\), yani 4 terms, to \(11 = 2 + 3d\).
\[3d = 9 \Rightarrow d = 3\]
\[A_{1} = 2 + 3 = 5\]
\[A_{2} = 5 + 3 = 8\]
Tasdeeq: \(8 + 3 = 11\). Jawab: 5 aur 8.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(a, A, b\) A.P. mein hon to \(A\) A.M. hai, aur \(A = \frac{a + b}{2}\) (seedha average).
2. \(n\) A.M.s ke saath \(a, A_{1}, \ldots, A_{n}, b\) ek A.P. hai jis mein \(n + 2\) terms hain.
3. \(d\) ke liye \(b = a + (n + 1)d\), phir \(d\) baar baar jama karein.
4. Tasdeeq: aakhri mean mein \(d\) jama karne se \(b\) aana chahiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Terms ki ginti ghalat lena: teen means ke saath \(b\) 5th term hai, is liye \(b = a + 4d\), \(a + 3d\) nahin.
2. \(a\) aur \(b\) ko bhi means mein gin lena: means sirf beech wale numbers hain.
3. Surds mein ghalti: \(3\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{2} = 2\sqrt{2}\) hai, 3 nahin; \(\sqrt{2}\) ko ek cheez samajh kar hisaab karein.
4. \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\) aur \(\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}\) ko alag jawab samajhna: dono barabar hain.
